sources.title: Final UK greenhouse gas emissions statistics: 1990 to 2024

facts.source_fact: The 2026 methodology note documents planned shipping-method changes for the final 1990-2024 UK GHG statistics.
Domestic shipping ship-movement estimates are normalised against DUKES fuel-sales data.
facts.expected_handling: Keep movement-model and fuel-sales reconciliation evidence.

facts.source_fact: The previous domestic-shipping method relied on ship movements alone and could be inconsistent with DUKES fuel use.
facts.expected_handling: Mark movement-only results as superseded method output.

facts.source_fact: The normalisation also applies to modelled inland-waterway and port-machinery emissions.
facts.expected_handling: Keep sub-source scope with the normalisation step.

facts.source_fact: Naval shipping is not normalised in the same way because it is based on Ministry of Defence fuel purchases.
facts.expected_handling: Apply a separate provenance route for naval shipping.

facts.source_fact: Global AIS data from 2019 are incorporated, replacing the earlier reliance on UK AIS data from 2014.
The shipping-method changes decrease UK domestic-shipping emissions estimates across the historic time series.
facts.expected_handling: Treat the change as a methodology effect rather than new measured activity.

facts.source_fact: At-berth emissions are no longer double counted between domestic and international shipping and are allocated to domestic shipping in line with IPCC guidance.
facts.expected_handling: Enforce single allocation of at-berth emissions.

facts.source_fact: Removing at-berth double counting reduces UK-based international-shipping estimates across the time series.
facts.expected_handling: Separate international memorandum-item effects from UK-total effects.

facts.source_fact: International shipping emissions are excluded from the UK total under IPCC reporting conventions even though they are reported in other policy contexts.
facts.expected_handling: Carry reporting-boundary metadata with international shipping values.

guard_patterns.handling: Attach AIS geography and data vintage.
Distinguish domestic, inland, port, naval and international sources.
Cross-check planning note against final release for final values.
Do not infer parcel emissions from national shipping models.
Flag unresolved fuel, AIS or boundary conflicts.

generation_rule: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT facts x guard_patterns; 10 x 10 = 100 controls
